description: A downward hull contains its point, is closed, and is least.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WellFoundedRecursion.downwardHull_spec.{v} {α : Type v} (R : α → α → Prop) (a : α) :
  a ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WellFoundedRecursion.downwardHull R a ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WellFoundedRecursion.DownwardClosed R
        (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WellFoundedRecursion.downwardHull R a) ∧
      ∀ (D : Set α),
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WellFoundedRecursion.DownwardClosed R D →
          a ∈ D → Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WellFoundedRecursion.downwardHull R a ⊆ D
